A file the app ships with, such as an image, located by an address.

sections.title: Setup
sections.what: Imports the picture lookup and the helper that builds asset addresses.

sections.name: IndustryBackdrop
sections.title: Industry banner
sections.what: Shows the banner with its picture, label, title and optional description.
sections.why: The code comment says it only reflects scope, so it must never be used to filter.
sections.watch_out: The picture's alt text comes from the lookup, and a missing alt text would hurt screen reader users.

summary: A banner with a photo for an industry, a small label, a title and an optional description, used to give project context.
purpose: Adds a visual cue for which industry is in scope without changing any filter.
why: The code comment says it reflects existing scope and is never a source of filter state, and the design keeps it display-only.
how: Looks up a picture for the industry slug, then shows the picture, the label, the title and the optional description.
inputs: An optional industry slug, a title, an optional label that defaults to Project context, and an optional description.
outputs: A rendered banner. Nothing is sent back.
risks: If the slug is unknown, the picture lookup decides what to return, and this file does not check the result.
debug: If the wrong picture or none appears, check the slug passed in and the `industryImage` lookup in content.
